data.one_liner: Extensible NMEA0183 parser with checksum validation support for GPS devices and sensors.
data.what_it_does: Decodes NMEA0183 sentences from string data or streams. Supports custom sentence registration, checksum validation, and multipart messages.
use_when: Reading and parsing GPS or marine sensor data in Dart or Flutter
Processing NMEA sentences from text streams using stream transformers
avoid_when: You need high-level mapping or geolocation abstractions rather than raw NMEA sentence parsing
strengths: Extensible sentence definitions with custom parsers
Can be used as a StreamTransformer
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of custom sentence types for proprietary or unhandled NMEA formats
